title: LINQ API in .NET
description: Explore the LINQ API architecture, including the Enumerable and Queryable classes, and how they enable LINQ queries.

data.text: We can write LINQ queries for classes that implement the `IEnumerable<T>` or `IQueryable<T>` interface. The `System.Linq` namespace includes the classes and interfaces required for LINQ queries.

data.title: System.Linq Namespace
data.text: The `System.Linq` namespace is included by default when you add a new class in Visual Studio. It contains all the core types needed for LINQ queries.

LINQ queries use extension methods for classes that implement `IEnumerable` or `IQueryable` interfaces. The `Enumerable` and `Queryable` are two static classes that contain extension methods to write LINQ queries.

data.text: The `Enumerable` class includes extension methods for classes that implement the `IEnumerable<T>` interface. All built-in collection classes in .NET implement `IEnumerable<T>`, so we can write LINQ queries to retrieve data from these collections.
Use `Enumerable` extension methods when working with in-memory collections like:

data.title: Using Enumerable Extension Methods
data.content: LINQ queries on in-memory collections use Enumerable

data.text: The `Queryable` class includes extension methods for classes that implement the `IQueryable<T>` interface. The `IQueryable<T>` interface provides querying capabilities against a specific data source where the type of the data is known.
For example, Entity Framework implements `IQueryable<T>` to support LINQ queries with underlying databases such as MS SQL Server.

data.title: Queryable with Entity Framework
data.content: LINQ queries on databases use Queryable

data.text: There are APIs available to access third-party data. For example, **LINQ to Amazon** provides the ability to use LINQ with Amazon web services to search for books and other items. This is achieved by implementing the `IQueryable` interface for Amazon.

terms.definition: An interface that allows iteration over a collection. All LINQ to Objects queries work on this interface.
An interface that provides querying capabilities for remote data sources. Queries are translated to the native query language (e.g., SQL).
A static class that contains extension methods for IEnumerable<T> types, used for in-memory queries.
A static class that contains extension methods for IQueryable<T> types, used for remote data source queries.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: LINQ queries work with IEnumerable<T> and IQueryable<T> interfaces
Enumerable class provides extension methods for in-memory collections
Queryable class provides extension methods for remote data sources
Third-party providers can implement IQueryable for LINQ support
